values.title: The horse invites us to listen.
values.body:
The guide points at the water. The horse looks down. There is already a horse in there, and it seems to have strong opinions about the guide. Nobody mentioned a committee.

Perhaps the next explanation can wait. What is the horse being invited into? The guide can look at the reflection too. You can read the little fable your own way—or just enjoy a horse declining a well-prepared presentation.
values.introduction: An encounter at the water’s edge.

values.title: An unexpected beginning
values.body: An encounter starts when the visitor can answer back.

values.prompt: What changes when we make room for an answer?

overrides.introduction: Listen for the question before offering your answer.
Begin with the invitation you are making. What room does your design leave for another response?

overrides.invitation: This invitation belongs to discovery alone.
